svg.title: Hi, I'm Yang. Frameworks, runtimes & small worlds.

g.text: Ten-plus years on the web, lately building AI products — billing,
real-time analytics and low-code platforms — in React, TypeScript and
Bun. After hours: frameworks, runtimes and roguelikes.
